    ONE PLATFORM.
    INFINITE STORIES.

    Image, video, voice, audio. Every asset generated, edited, and stitched together without leaving the platform.

    Director mode

    Direct your videos through chat.

    Director mode gives you a whole new level of control in AI video generation, whether you want a loose creative direction or precise granular edits. Layout the storyboard, shape each shot by natural chat, and let the AI help you refine the final sequence.

    Start Directing → Learn More

    AI Video Generation

    Create cinematic videos from text or images

    Type a prompt or drop a reference image in the AI video generator to create a video up to 15 seconds long, in up to 4K resolution. Experiment between Veo 3.1, Seedance 2.5, Kling 3.0 Omni, or Wan 3.0 for different outputs. And pick any style or genre you like: photorealism, anime, vintage, and many more. Each generation can be further refined or edited.

    Start Creating → Learn More

    AI Image Generation & Editing

    Generate, edit, and transform any image

    Generate images with GPT Image 2, Nano Banana Pro, or Seedream 5.0. Then edit the same image in the same canvas - erase, expand, swap backgrounds, restyle, or upscale to 4K. Drop in a reference image and likeness holds across every edit.

    Start Creating → Learn More

    Character

    Create AI characters for use across images and videos

    Consistent faces used to be the hardest thing to get right in AI imagery, but that's no longer the case with OpenArt. Build a Character using reference images or text brief, save it to your OpenArt library, and then simply tag and reuse them in future generations so they keep the same look.

    Start Creating → Learn More

    World

    Make entire worlds with a single text prompt

    OpenArt Worlds lets you generate a huge, persistent spatial environment in full 3D, fully navigable, from a single prompt or reference images. You can then place characters inside it, add objects and props, take still photos, or export the environment to specialized 3D tools.

    Start Creating → Learn More

    AI Music & Audio

    Add voice, music, and sounds to your stories

    Generate AI voice-overs with lip-sync, score scenes with original music in any genre, or layer sounds like footsteps and rain over footage. Clone a voice from a reference sample or pick a preset. Every audio track exports as WAV or MP3, timed to your video.

    Start Creating → Learn More

    Frequently Asked Questions

    OpenArt is an all-in-one platform for creating AI images and videos. Whether you want a product ad, a TikTok reel, a short film, or a virtual character that posts content for you, you can make it all on OpenArt, without specialized editing software, design background, or technical skills.

    You can cancel any time from Profile, then Subscriptions, then Cancel Plan. Cancel at least 5 days before your renewal date to avoid the next charge. You keep access and your remaining credits until the end of the current billing period, and unused monthly credits do not roll over. Because generation costs are incurred when you create, completed generations and active subscription periods are generally not refundable. If you bought an annual plan by mistake, contact support@openart.ai to switch to monthly and get a partial refund, minus a 10% processing fee. Full details are in the Help Center.

    OpenArt brings leading AI models together in one place, including Seedance 2.5, Kling 3.0, Veo 3.1, Wan 3.0, MiniMax H3 and Grok Imagine for video, GPT Image 2.5, Nano Banana Pro, Seedream 5.0 Pro and FLUX 3 Image for images, and Lyria 3 for music. Instead of paying for several separate tools, you get them all under one subscription and pick whichever model fits the content you're making.

    Yes. You can make videos where characters speak with synced lip movements, add original AI-generated music, and include realistic sound effects, all inside OpenArt. Great for everything from quick social clips to full cinematic videos.

    Most AI tools specialize in one thing. Midjourney is mainly for images, Sora and Runway are built for video. But OpenArt brings images, videos, characters, music, and editing into one place, with every leading AI model built in. You don't need five different subscriptions or constantly move files between separate apps.

    Yes. Your creations stay private, payments are handled securely, and OpenArt has safeguards in place to keep the platform safe and responsible, so you can create with confidence whether you're creating for personal or professional use.

    Yes, you can start for free. New accounts get 40 free credits, no credit card required. Every generation uses credits, and the exact cost shows before you click Generate. To keep creating, choose a paid plan. You can compare plans, prices and annual billing options on the pricing page. Commercial use requires the Plus plan or above. Plans renew automatically, monthly credits do not roll over, and extra credits are only sold as add-ons to a paid plan. You can cancel any time from Profile, then Subscriptions. Cancel at least 5 days before your renewal date to avoid the next charge, and you keep access until the end of the billing period. Completed generations and active subscription periods are generally not refundable. Full billing, cancellation and refund details are in the Help Center.

    Yes, on the Plus plan and above. Paid Plus, Pro and Wonder plans include commercial use, so you can use what you create in ads, on social media, in client work and on merchandise, with no royalties or attribution required. The free trial and the Starter plan cover non-commercial use only. OpenArt makes no ownership claim over what you generate, and you are responsible for making sure your content does not infringe anyone else's rights. See the Terms of Service for full details.

    Yes! This is one of OpenArt's most-loved features. Create a character once, and you can place them in any outfit, scene, or video with the same face and look every time. It's how creators build AI influencers, recurring brand mascots, and full stories with consistent characters.

    Yes. OpenArt exports in every format and aspect ratio you need: vertical for TikTok, Reels, and Shorts; widescreen for YouTube and ads; square for Instagram feeds; and cinematic ratios for film. Just pick the platform and your video comes out ready to post.

    Not at all. OpenArt is built for everyday creators. You describe what you want in plain words, pick a style, and the platform handles the rest. If you want more control, advanced tools are there when you're ready and you can always refine your prompts, but you can still make great content from your very first try.
